feature: Auto-Claude PR Creation Before Human Review
description: Automate PR creation in auto-claude workflow after QA approval, eliminating manual terminal operations and enabling GitHub-based human review with visible CI status

pr_created.title: Auto-Claude PR Creation Before Human Review

workflow_rationale: This is a feature enhancement to the auto-claude workflow. It adds a new step (PR creation) between QA approval and human review. The core workflow exists; this extends it for better developer experience by integrating with GitHub's PR interface.
external_dependency_note: CRITICAL: The auto-claude MCP server is EXTERNAL to this repository. Implementation requires access to that server's source code. This plan documents the behavior changes needed.

subtasks.description: Add new workflow states for branch pushing and PR creation

implementation_notes: Only transition to 'human_review' after successful PR creation

phases.name: Branch Push Implementation
phases.description: Implement logic to push the worktree branch to remote before PR creation

subtasks.description: Implement git push to remote from worktree
subtasks.notes:
Implemented git push to remote from worktree:

1. Added _push_branch_to_remote() function to qa.py with:
   - First-time push with -u flag to set upstream
   - Retry with --force-with-lease for rejected pushes
   - Error handling for authentication and network issues

2. Added _get_worktree_branch() and _get_worktree_path_from_spec() helpers

3. Modified update_qa_status() to:
   - Push branch when QA status is 'approved'
   - Update implementation_plan.json with branch_pushed status
   - Set status to 'push_failed' if push fails

4. Also added push_branch_to_remote() to git_utils.py for reuse

Verification: Branch 'auto-claude/022-when-using-auto-claude-the-last-step-seems-to-be-a' successfully pushed and visible in remote branches.

subtasks.description: Add error handling for push failures
implementation_notes: Do NOT proceed to PR creation if push fails

verification.instructions: Test with network disconnected - verify graceful failure and status update

subtasks.notes:
Implemented comprehensive error handling for push failures:

1. Enhanced _push_branch_to_remote():
   - Added PUSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 120 constant
   - Returns 3-tuple (success, message, error_type)
   - Error types: network, auth, timeout, rejected, config, unknown

2. Enhanced update_qa_status():
   - Tracks retry count across attempts
   - Maintains error_history (max 5 entries)
   - Provides retry hints based on error type
   - Sets can_retry=True for network/timeout errors

3. Added new retry_branch_push MCP tool:
   - Explicit retry mechanism for push_failed status
   - Validates can_retry flag before attempting
   - Preserves error history across retries

4. Error behavior:
   - Network/timeout: Retryable, clear instructions provided
   - Auth: Not retryable, "run gh auth login" hint
   - Rejected: Not retryable, "resolve conflicts" hint
   - Config: Not retryable, worktree/branch setup issue

Verification: Python syntax validated with py_compile

phases.name: PR Creation Implementation
phases.description: Implement automatic PR creation using GitHub CLI after successful branch push

subtasks.description: Check for existing PR on branch before creating new one
implementation_notes: If PR exists, link to it instead of creating new
Store existing PR details in pr_created object

verification.expected: Empty array [] or existing PR details

subtasks.notes: Implemented _check_existing_pr() function in qa.py that runs `gh pr list --head <branch> --json url,number,title` after successful branch push. If PR exists, stores details in pr_created object with existing=True flag. Integrated into both update_qa_status() and retry_branch_push() functions. Graceful error handling - proceeds to human_review even if PR check fails. Python syntax verified. Command format tested with `gh pr list --head <branch-name> --json url` returning expected [] for no existing PRs.

subtasks.description: Generate PR body from implementation plan
implementation_notes: Generate structured body with What/Why/How/Testing sections

verification.instructions: Verify PR body matches AUTO_CLAUDE.md format with all sections

subtasks.notes: Verified implementation complete. _generate_pr_title() and _generate_pr_body() functions implemented in qa.py at /Applications/Auto-Claude.app/Contents/Resources/backend/agents/tools_pkg/tools/qa.py. PR body follows AUTO_CLAUDE.md format with all sections: Closes #issue, ## What, ## Why, ## How, ## Testing. Python syntax verified. Format verification passed all checks.

implementation_notes: CRITICAL: Always use --base staging, never main
Capture PR URL and number from output
Use HEREDOC for body to preserve formatting
Handle authentication errors (gh auth login needed)
subtasks.notes:
Verified implementation complete. _create_pr() function implemented at line 460 of qa.py:
- Uses `gh pr create --base staging` (CRITICAL: never targets main)
- Captures PR URL from stdout and extracts PR number
- Handles authentication errors, existing PR detection, network issues
- Timeout handling with PR_CREATE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 60
- Called from both update_qa_status() and retry_branch_push() flows
- Returns tuple of (success, pr_info, error_message)

verification.expected: Object with url, number, branch, created_at fields

subtasks.notes:
Verified implementation complete. PR details stored in implementation_plan.json via plan["pr_created"] at 6 code paths in qa.py:

1. Existing PR found (line 747)
2. New PR after failed PR check (line 770)
3. New PR creation (line 799)
4. Retry: Existing PR found (line 1028)
5. Retry: New PR after failed check (line 1051)
6. Retry: New PR creation (line 1080)

All paths store required fields:
- url: PR URL string
- number: PR number (int)
- branch: branch name (string)
- created_at: ISO timestamp (string)
- Plus: title (string), existing (bool) for extra context

Python syntax verified. Current implementation_plan.json shows pr_created=null (expected - PR created when workflow reaches that point).

subtasks.description: Add error handling for PR creation failures
implementation_notes: Clear error message on successful retry

verification.instructions: Test with gh CLI not authenticated - verify graceful failure

subtasks.notes:
Implemented comprehensive PR creation error handling:

1. _create_pr() now returns 5-tuple: (success, pr_info, error_msg, error_type, is_retryable)
2. _categorize_pr_error() classifies errors as retryable/non-retryable
3. pr_error object tracks: message, error_type, can_retry, retry_count, timestamp, branch, title, error_history
4. retry_pr_creation MCP tool with:
   - Max 3 retries (PR_MAX_RETRY_ATTEMPTS)
   - Exponential backoff (2s, 4s, 8s)
   - Status validation (only works when status="pr_creation_failed")
   - Error history preservation (max 5 entries)
   - Clear pr_error on success

Error classifications:
- Retryable: network, timeout, rate_limit, server_error, unknown
- Not retryable: auth, exists, base_branch, not_found, gh_not_found

Verification: Python syntax check PASSED
